st: Pups and the Stinky Bubble Trouble; Pups Save the Baby Ostriches
d: A strange odor chases jungle animals away from their homes; after Olivia the Ostrich falls into a canyon, the pups work together to lift her to safety and protect her soon-to-hatch eggs.

st: Pups Save a Giant Plant; Pups Get Stuck
d: Mayor Goodway's gesture of goodwill gift grows out of control when it is planted in the wrong place; Marshall's fire truck becomes mysteriously magnetized.

st: Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Shark; Sea Patrol: Pups Save the Pier
d: Humdinger makes a robotic shark to scare everyone away from the beach; the pups come to the rescue when the pier has a broken support post.

st: The Pups Winter Wonder Show
d: When Mayor Humdinger escapes with Cap'n Turbot's performing penguins right before the Adventure Bay Snow Show, Tracker and the PAW Patrol must get them back.

st: Pup Pup Boogie; Pups in a Fog
d: Rubble hurts his paw while trying to fix the train tracks; Ryder and the PAW Patrol must fix the bulb in the Adventure Bay lighthouse.

st: Pups Save the Parrot; Pups Save the Queen Bee
d: The PAW Patrol heads to the jungle to help their friend find his lost parrot; the PAW Patrol discovers a beehive in Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse.

st: Pups Save a Pluck-O-Matic; Pups Save a Mascot
d: Yumi's new Robo-Corn Plucker goes haywire; Ryder and the "PAW Patrol" must get it under control; Daring Danny X, dressed as a "Bird X" mascot, gets carried away by a couple of eagles.

st: The Crew Builds a Fountain Show; The Crew Builds a Carousel
d: When Sierra Sparkle's big concert stage needs some extra sparkle, Rubble and Crew use a construction complication to make a big splash; Rubble and Crew decide to go big when Grocer Gabriel wants something special built.

st: The Crew Builds a Train Station; The Crew Builds a Sierra Sparkle Sign
d: Rubble and Crew build the first train station in Builder Cove just in time to welcome Farmer Zoe's new cow, Mooreen; Popstar Sierra Sparkle is moving to Builder Cove, but when the pups plan a surprise greeting, Speed Meister makes a plan of his own.

st: The Crew Fixes the Talent Show Stage; The Crew Builds Instruments
d: When Speed Meister sabotages the stage for the town talent show, the pups use Motor's talent to save the day; Sierra Sparkle comes to sing for Builder Cove Day, but when the band's instruments break, Rubble & Crew have a construction solution.

st: The Crew and Chase Are on the Case
d: When the sculpture of all the townsfolk suddenly disappears, Chase joins Rubble & Crew to solve the case of the missing statue and build a brand new Science Center to help investigate.

st: The Crew Builds a Giant Dam; The Crew Builds a Squirrel-Proof Farm
d: Rubble & Crew are on the job to save Builder Cove after a rainstorm threatens to flood the town; Rubble and Motor come up with crafty construction solutions to fix Farmer Zoe's squirrel problem before the Farm Fair.

st: The Crew Builds a Mini Golf Course; The Crew Builds a Butterfly Garden
d: When a family of bunnies hops onto the soccer field, Rubble and Crew use their construction skills to build a new sport, Bunny Ball; after the pups discover a new kind of butterfly, it flutters away.

st: The Crew Builds an Ice Cream Shop; The Crew Fixes a Squeak
d: When a windy day derails construction on an ice cream shop, Rubble & Crew are on the chase; there's a mysterious squeak in City Hall, so Mayor Greatway asks Rubble and Charger to find and fix the squeak before her big speech.

st: The Crew Builds a Beaver Home; The Crew Fixes a Road
d: When the pups find out a beaver is to blame for the power being out, they build it a new home to bring the power back.

st: The Crew Builds a Popcorn Café; The Crew Fixes a Slippery Mess
d: The crew switches to cleanup mode when construction on Café Carl's new popcorn restaurant pops out of control; a soapy accident causes slippery mayhem all over Builder Cove.

st: The Crew Builds a Bridge
d: Rubble and his construction pup family gear up to build a bridge, only to find the villainous Speed Meister has a different idea; it's up to Rubble and crew to work together and save the day by building a new, safe bridge to Builder Cove.

st: The Crew Builds a Skate Park; The Crew Builds a Tunnel
d: The pups find out Auntie Crane is a secret skateboarding star, but while building a surprise skate park, they have to fix a cement mix mishap; Charger's favorite singer, Sierra Sparkle, is coming to town.

st: The Crew Builds a Drive-In Movie Theater; The Crew Finds a Rainbow Treasure
d: When Mix and Motor's favorite TV star has a new movie playing in Builder Cove, the pups need to build a movie theater to watch it; Grandpa tells the pups about a buried treasure, and they find out the key to finding this treasure is teamwork.

st: The Crew Builds a Car Wash; The Crew Plans Grandpa Day
d: Mayor Greatway needs her muddy motorcycle cleaned fast, so Wheeler and the pups jump into action to build a solution before the big race; it's Grandpa Gravel's special day, but when the pups are needed, they have to change their Grandpa Day plans.

st: The Crew Builds a Library Tunnel; The Crew Builds a Super Snack Dispenser
d: Rubble and Crew's favorite book series has new additions; the pups have a surprise just for Rubble, a snack dispenser.

st: The Crew Builds a Roller Coaster; The Crew Builds Motor a Play Space
d: When Speed Meister's roller coaster sends a pet play date out of control, Rubble and Crew save the day with a bigger, better and safer coaster; the Bark Yard safety inspection is today, but Motor going boom could cost the crew.

st: The Crew Builds Hair Salon; The Crew Builds a Colorful Crystal Show
d: Rubble and Crew build a hair salon just in time for Grandpa Gravel's special photo; Motor and Lily make a shiny discovery worth celebrating.

st: The Crew Builds a Gym; The Crew Puts on a Construction Show
d: Coach Karima asks Rubble and Crew to build a gym for the gymnastics show; when the beam is too high for Lily, it's up to the pups to save the day; when a traveling show can't get to Builder Cove, Rubble and Crew decides to build a show of their own!

st: The Crew Builds a Parking Garage; The Crew Builds a Campsite
d: Café Carl's new ice cream machine brings lots of cars to Builder Cove; Rubble's fear of the dark derails the pup's Bark Yard campout.

st: The Crew Builds a Ferris Wheel; The Crew Builds a Farm Animal Yoga Space
d: Rubble and Crew want to give Grocer Gabriel the best beach day ever, including a ride on a brand-new Ferris wheel at the boardwalk; when Farmer Zoe's animals need some relaxation, the pups build a perfect place to practice yoga with Coach Karima.

st: The Crew Builds a Smoothie Shop; The Crew Builds a Dino Roof Party
d: Café Carl opens up a smoothie shop on the boardwalk, but when the coaster causes coconut chaos, "Rubble & Crew" know just what to do; "Rubble & Crew" work together to find a construction solution when Charger's bouncy birthday surprise needs a lift.

st: The Crew and Skye Build a Mountain Lodge
d: Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove, where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.

st: The Crew Builds a Treehouse; The Crew Builds a Chicken Feeder
d: Park Ranger Rose's favorite old tree is off limits for fun climbing, unless Rubble and Grandpa can come up with a construction solution; Rubble and Crew are building a feeder for Farmer Zoe's chickens.

st: The Arctic Life!
d: Gil embarks on an icy expedition to the North Pole.

st: Bubble Puppy!
d: The Bubble Guppies learn how to care for pets when Gil wants to adopt a puppy.

st: Genie in a Bubble!
d: When Nonny, Gil and Zooli conjure a genie, she agrees to grant a wish to whoever brings her the most precious gift.

st: The Big Rig Bandit!
d: When reckless hyena Spotty steals young elephant Eli from the savanna, Wildlife Rangers Zooli and Goby hop into their big rig to rescue him; when the big rig chase lands Spotty and Eli in danger, it's up to the Guppies to save the day.

st: The Lonely Rhino
d: The Guppies learn about the zoo while trying to find a friend for a lonely rhinoceros.

st: Bubble Baby!
d: Molly is going to have a new sibling; the Guppies get excited about babies; the children go to the hospital to meet a new baby.

st: Firefighter Gil to the Rescue!
d: Gil and his team of firefighters must rescue another firefighter who is stuck in a tree.

st: Search for the Great Silverback!
d: When primatologists Zooli and Gil are looking in the rainforest for a silverback gorilla, they're chased into an ancient temple by a robotic silverback that turns out to be a tiny marmoset guarding a sanctuary of mountain gorillas.

st: Fruit Camp!
d: Deema must turn over a new leaf and try broccoli if she wants to earn her broccoli badge at scout troop initiation.

st: It's a Lizard!
d: When showman Gil's real live dragon (actually a Komodo dragon) gets loose in the small town of Bubbleville, it's up to Pet Finders Oona and Zooli to track the lizard down and return it to its home on Komodo Island.

st: The Beach Ball!
d: Molly's friend needs the Guppies' help to finish her work in time to attend the Big Beach Ball.

st: Escape From Volcano Island!
d: Skipper Molly and First Mate Gil are shipwrecked on Volcano Island, and it's about to erupt; parts of their boat start to mysteriously disappear.
